legal.aviso.body:
1. Website owner

In compliance with Law 34/2002 of 11 July on information society services and electronic commerce (LSSI-CE), users are informed that the website emili.godes.org (hereinafter, ‘the website’) is a non-profit cultural and family project owned by Família Godes / hereus d'Emili Godes, heirs of the photographer Emili Godes Hurtado (Barcelona, 1895–1970). {{contactVia}}

2. Purpose

The website aims to disseminate the life, work and legacy of the photographer Emili Godes: biography, photographic catalogue, research texts and documentary sources. It does not offer commercial products or services.

3. Intellectual property

The texts, structure, design and code of the website belong to the rights holder or their respective authors and are published for personal, educational and research consultation. Photographs by Emili Godes are reproduced with an indication of the institution or collection that holds them and their reference number (MNAC, IEFC, Filmoteca de Catalunya, Arxiu Fotogràfic de Barcelona, Museo Reina Sofía, Museo Universidad de Navarra and private collections). Rights in each image belong to their respective holders. Any use beyond personal consultation (reproduction, publication, commercial use) requires prior authorisation from the rights holder and, where applicable, from the institution that holds the original. Works by other authors included for comparative purposes in the ‘A modern eye’ section are reproduced at low resolution, with their source cited, under the right of quotation for analysis and teaching purposes.

4. Content removal and corrections

If you believe that any content infringes your rights, contains identification or dating errors, or includes personal data that should be corrected or removed, you can report it through the contact form. Requests are handled as promptly as possible, and corrections are recorded without deleting the research history.

5. Liability

The information published comes from research, family archives, heritage institutions and historical publications; where information is awaiting confirmation, this is indicated. The rights holder does not guarantee the absolute accuracy of all data and accepts no responsibility for third-party use of the information. Links to external websites are provided for information only; the rights holder does not control and is not responsible for their content.

6. Applicable law

This legal notice is governed by Spanish law. Any dispute shall fall within the jurisdiction of the courts and tribunals of Barcelona unless applicable law provides otherwise.

legal.cookies.body:
1. What cookies are

Cookies are small text files stored by your browser when you visit a website. They are used to remember preferences or collect usage statistics. This website uses essential first-party cookies and, only with your consent, third-party analytics cookies.

2. Cookies used by this website

CookieTypePurposeDuration
eg_consentFirst-party · necessaryRemembers your choice regarding analytics cookies.180 days
eg_langFirst-party · necessaryRemembers the language you selected so you are not asked again when entering via the home page.1 year
_ga, _ga_*Third-party (Google Analytics) · analyticsDistinguishes visitors and sessions in order to produce anonymous usage statistics. Installed only if you accept analytics cookies.Up to 2 years

Google Analytics is loaded through Google Tag Manager in ‘consent mode’: until you accept, no analytics cookie is stored and no identifiers are sent. More information is available in Google’s cookie policy.

3. How to change your choice

You can accept, reject or change analytics cookie settings at any time through the ‘Cookie preferences’ link in the footer. You can also delete or block cookies in your browser settings; in that case, some preferences (such as language) will not be remembered.

4. Controller

The controller of this website is Família Godes / hereus d'Emili Godes. {{contactVia}} See also the privacy policy.

legal.privacy.body:
1. Data controller

The controller of the personal data collected on this website is Família Godes / hereus d'Emili Godes. {{contactVia}}

2. What data we process and why

Contact form

When you use the contact form, we process your name, email address and the content of your message solely to respond to your enquiry, contribution or correction request. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you provide by ticking the acceptance box before sending the form. Messages are sent through the email provider Resend and received in the rights holder’s inbox.

Usage statistics

If you accept analytics cookies, Google Analytics 4 (loaded via Google Tag Manager) collects statistical data about browsing (pages viewed, device, approximate country, source of visit) in order to understand how the website is used and improve it. The legal basis is your consent, which you can withdraw at any time through ‘Cookie preferences’ in the footer. Without your consent, these cookies are not loaded. Details are available in the cookie policy.

Technical data

The website hosting provider (Cloudflare Pages) automatically records technical connection data (IP address, date, requested page) for security and service operation purposes, acting as a data processor. The contact form uses Cloudflare Turnstile to prevent automated message submissions.

3. Retention

Messages received through the form are retained for as long as necessary to deal with the enquiry and, if the contribution is incorporated into the research, for as long as the project continues. Google Analytics statistical data are retained according to the tool’s configuration (14 months).

4. Recipients

Data are not disclosed to third parties except to the technology providers required to deliver the service (Cloudflare, Resend, Google), which act as data processors. Some of these providers may process data outside the European Economic Area with the safeguards provided for under the GDPR (standard contractual clauses or adequacy decisions).

5. Your rights

You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and data portability, as well as withdraw consent, by contacting the rights holder through the contact form. If you believe the processing does not comply with the law, you may lodge a complaint with the Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (www.aepd.es).

6. Data relating to people identified in photographs

The website publishes historical photographs in which people may be identified by name, for historical and documentary research purposes. If you are one of these people or a family member and would like an identification to be corrected or removed, you can request this through the contact form.
